plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions reports written by the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's intelligence branch. He says Tim Gallaudet, a former senior Navy officer, talks a lot about USOs, objects seen moving underwater that no one can identify. If true, it would mean the Navy has been tracking unexplained things in the sea as well as in the sky.
